title: Reminders: after a switch to another record, the old record's last good read stands in for a failed read before the permission ask, so it can vouch for the new record's erase
evidence: Done: fixed by this PR. From the owner's review of PR 1597. ios/HealthRoadmap/Reminders/ReminderScheduler.swift kept lastEpoch, the last good read, through a switch between phone and cloud records, and ReminderMode.swift asking x asked uses it when the read as the ask began fails. Switch down: record A read at epoch 5; the person switches to record B (epoch 1); B's read before the ask fails; B is erased to epoch 2 while iOS answers; the grant compared A's 5 with B's 2 and turned reminders on for the erased record (US-11). Switch up: record A read at epoch 0; switch to record B at epoch 3 whose read before the ask fails; the grant compared A's 0 with B's 3 and ended off, as an erase would (fails safe, S40). Fix: ReminderScheduler.recordSourceChanged() clears lastEpoch, called from RootView's .onChange(of: source); with no good read of the new record the grant ends off in both cases, and the next tap after a good read turns reminders on. Pins: ReminderSchedulerTests switch down, switch up, and a good read after a switch restores the fallback (_US25_AC12b). US-25 AC12b
